source.title: OCT to Assess Risk of Progression of Multiple Sclerosis: A Report by the American Academy of Ophthalmology.

source.title: Effect of Resident Involvement in Ophthalmic Surgery on Patient Outcomes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Resident-led surgeries appear overall safe, effective, and comparable to attending-led surgeries with respect to commonly encountered perioperative complications. cards.headline: Wer Allah und Seinen Engeln und Seinen Gesandten und Gibril und Mikal feind ist …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:98
source.excerpt: من عادى الله وملائكته، ورسله من الملائكة أو البشر، وبخاصة المَلَكان جبريلُ وميكالُ؛ لأن اليهود زعموا أن جبريل عدوهم، وميكال وليُّهم، فأعلمهم الله أنه من عادى واحدًا منهما فقد عادى الآخر، وعادى الله أيضًا، فإن الله عدو للجاحدين ما أنزل على رسوله محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم.

cards.arabic: مَن كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّلَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَجِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَىٰلَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَدُوٌّ لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
cards.translation: Wer Allah und Seinen Engeln und Seinen Gesandten und Gibril und Mikal feind ist, so ist Allah den Ungläubigen feind.

cards.headline: Und Wir haben zu dir ja (im Qur’an) klare Zeichen hinabgesandt.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:99
source.excerpt: ولقد أنزلنا إليك -أيها الرسول- آيات بينات واضحات تدل على أنّك رسول من الله صدقا وحقا، وما ينكر تلك الآيات إلا الخارجون عن دين الله.

cards.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ ۖ وَمَا يَكْفُرُ بِهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
cards.translation: Und Wir haben zu dir ja (im Qur’an) klare Zeichen hinabgesandt. Doch nur die Frevler verleugnen sie.

cards.body: Proofs of Muhammad's ﷺ Prophethood: Imam Abu Ja`far bin Jarir said that Allah's statement, وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ءَايَـتٍ بَيِّنَـتٍ (And indeed We have sent down to you manifest Ayat) means, "We have sent to you, O Muhammad, clear signs that testify to your prophethood."

cards.headline: Epidemiology of Cataract-Related Blindness in Brazil

source.title: Epidemiology of Cataract-Related Blindness in Brazil: 30 Years of Public Policy Evolution: A Review Article.
source.excerpt: The increase in surgeries was driven by unlimited federal funding, private contracts, and targeted parliamentary amendments. Despite these efforts, regional disparities persist, requiring equitable policies based on local epidemiologic data. Ensuring access to cataract surgery demands sustained public investment.

source.excerpt: IDX-DR is a highly effective diagnostic tool for diabetic retinopathy screening, with robust sensitivity and good specificity. Its integration into clinical practice, especially in resource-limited settings, can potentially improve early detection and reduce vision loss.

source.excerpt: Schleswig-Holstein ist eine parlamentarische Republik und ein teilsouveräner Gliedstaat (Land) der Bundesrepublik Deutschland. Die Landeshauptstadt und bevölkerungsreichste Stadt des Landes ist die Großstadt Kiel; weitere Oberzentren sind die Großstadt Lübeck sowie die Mittelstädte Flensburg und Neumünster.

cards.headline: Pediatric Cataract Surgery Following Treatment for Retinoblastoma

source.title: Pediatric Cataract Surgery Following Treatment for Retinoblastoma: A Case Series and Systematic Review.
source.excerpt: Modern retinoblastoma therapies, including intravitreal chemotherapy and vitrectomy, cause secondary cataract. Following cataract surgery, intraocular recurrence risk is low and extraocular spread is rare. Although surgery improves tumor visualization, visual prognosis may be limited by several factors. Challenges include biometry limitations and a high incidence of zonulopathy.

cards.headline: Ist es nicht (so), daß jedesmal, wenn sie eine Verpflichtung eingingen …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:100
source.excerpt: ما أقبح حال بني إسرائيل في نقضهم للعهود!! فكلما عاهدوا عهدًا طرح ذلك العهد فريق منهم، ونقضوه، فتراهم يُبْرِمون العهد اليوم وينقضونه غدًا، بل أكثرهم لا يصدِّقون بما جاء به نبي الله ورسوله محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم.

cards.arabic: أَوَكُلَّمَا عَـٰهَدُوا۟ عَهْدًا نَّبَذَهُۥ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
cards.translation: Ist es nicht (so), daß jedesmal, wenn sie eine Verpflichtung eingingen, sie eine Gruppe von ihnen verworfen hat? - Nein! Vielmehr glauben die meisten von ihnen (doch) nicht.

cards.headline: Und als (nun) zu ihnen ein Gesandter von Allah gekommen ist, das bestätigend …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:101
source.excerpt: ولما جاءهم محمد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بالقرآن الموافق لما معهم من التوراة طرح فريق منهم كتاب الله، وجعلوه وراء ظهورهم، شأنهم شأن الجهال الذين لا يعلمون حقيقته.

cards.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ نَبَذَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ كِتَـٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
cards.translation: Und als (nun) zu ihnen ein Gesandter von Allah gekommen ist, das bestätigend, was ihnen (an Offenbarungen) bereits vorlag, da hat eine Gruppe von denjenigen, denen die Schrift gegeben wurde, das Buch Allahs hinter ihren Rücken geworfen, als ob sie nicht Bescheid wüßten.

cards.headline: Und sie folgten dem, was die Teufel unter der Herrschaft Sulaimans (den Menschen) …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:102
source.excerpt: واتبع اليهود ما تُحَدِّث الشياطينُ به السحرةَ على عهد ملك سليمان بن داود. وما كفر سليمان وما تَعَلَّم السِّحر، ولكنَّ الشياطين هم الذين كفروا بالله حين علَّموا الناس السحر; إفسادًا لدينهم.

cards.arabic: وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَا تَتْلُوا۟ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَـٰرُوتَ وَمَـٰرُوتَ ۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَآ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ ۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِۦ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا هُم بِضَآرِّينَ بِهِۦ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا۟ لَمَنِ ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَـٰقٍ ۚ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
cards.translation: Und sie folgten dem, was die Teufel unter der Herrschaft Sulaimans (den Menschen) verlasen. Nicht Sulaiman war ungläubig, sondern die Teufel waren es, indem sie die Menschen in der Zauberei unterwiesen und in dem, was auf die (beiden) engel(haften Männer) in Babel, Harut und Marut, herabgesandt worden war. Und sie (beide) unterwiesen niemanden (in der Zauberei), ohne zu sagen: „Wir sind nur eine Versuchung; so werde (darum) nicht ungläubig. Und so lernten sie von ihnen (beiden) das (Zaubermittel), womit man Zwietracht zwischen den Ehegatten stiftet. Doch können sie damit niemandem schaden, außer mit Allahs Erlaubnis. Und sie erlernten, was ihnen schadet und nicht nützt. Und sie wußten doch, daß, wer es erkaufte, am Jenseits wahrlich keinen Anteil hätte. Fürwahr, wie schlimm ist das, wofür sie ihre Seelen verkauft haben, wenn sie (es) nur wüßten!

cards.headline: Und wenn sie geglaubt hätten und gottesfürchtig gewesen wären …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:103
source.excerpt: ولو أن اليهود آمنوا وخافوا الله لأيقنوا أن ثواب الله خير لهم من السِّحر ومما اكتسبوه به، لو كانوا يعلمون ما يحصل بالإيمان والتقوى من الثواب والجزاء علما حقيقيا لآمنوا.

cards.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّقَوْا۟ لَمَثُوبَةٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ ۖ لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
cards.translation: Und wenn sie geglaubt hätten und gottesfürchtig gewesen wären, dann wäre eine Belohnung von Allah dafür wahrlich besser (als das, was sie erkauft haben), wenn sie (es) nur wüßten.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Proofs of Muhammad's ﷺ Prophethood: Imam Abu Ja`far bin Jarir said that Allah's statement, وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ءَايَـتٍ بَيِّنَـتٍ (And indeed We have sent down to you manifest Ayat) means, "We have sent to you, O Muhammad, clear signs that testify to your prophethood."

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in human microbiome research

source.title: Artificial intelligence in human microbiome research: from data integration to explainable translation.
source.excerpt: Leveraging AI in this field holds significant promise for accelerating precision medicine, improving diagnostics, and developing microbiome-targeted therapies, if interpretability and validation challenges are addressed.

cards.headline: Enhancing Outcome Measurement in Oncology Clinical Trials Through Artificial Intelligence

source.title: Enhancing Outcome Measurement in Oncology Clinical Trials Through Artificial Intelligence: A Scoping Review.
source.excerpt: Ultimately, early and sustained collaboration between trialists, AI developers, and regulators will be essential to ensure that AI delivers meaningful advances in the design, evaluation, and delivery of new medicines.

cards.headline: Intraretinal hyperreflective foci

source.title: Intraretinal hyperreflective foci: Pathophysiology, imaging features, and clinical implications across retinal diseases.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: This review provides a comprehensive synthesis of the current literature on IHRF, summarizing their proposed histopathological correlates, multimodal imaging features, molecular associations, prognostic significance, and potential role as biomarkers in a wide range of retinal disorders.

cards.headline: Shaping the Future of Limbal Stem Cell Therapy

source.title: Shaping the Future of Limbal Stem Cell Therapy: Advances in Substrates, Techniques, and Science for Cultivated Autologous and Allogeneic Limbal Epithelial Transplantation.
source.excerpt: We outline the key management principles in the treatment of LSCD, where a multi-disciplinary approach is essential in optimizing outcomes, and describe the current clinical and surgical options available. We also explore the emerging treatments on the horizon.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in gastric cancer research

source.title: Artificial intelligence in gastric cancer research: a bibliometric and visualized analysis from 1993 to 2026.
source.excerpt: The visualized map provides an intuitive overview of research landscape of AI applications in GC over the past 33 years. Over the last five years, research in this field has gradually intensified, and the trend is positive.

cards.headline: Association between sarcopenia and atrial fibrillation: a meta-analysis

source.title: Association between sarcopenia and atrial fibrillation: a meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: The study suggests a significant association between sarcopenia and AF, indicating that sarcopenia may be linked to an increased risk of AF. However, given the observed heterogeneity and potential publication bias, more high-quality research is needed to further substantiate these findings and confirm the nature of this relationship.

cards.headline: The perfusion-based model of AMD: Moving towards a unifying hypothesis

source.title: The perfusion-based model of AMD: Moving towards a unifying hypothesis.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: Understanding AMD as an end-organ vascular disease may move us towards a unifying hypothesis.

cards.headline: Advanced Corneal Imaging in Keratoconus: A Report by the American Academy of Ophthalmology

source.title: Advanced Corneal Imaging in Keratoconus: A Report by the American Academy of Ophthalmology.
source.excerpt: Modern corneal imaging devices provide improved characterization of the cornea and are accurate in detecting keratoconus with high AUCs ranging from 0.82 to 1.00. The detection of keratoconus suspects is less accurate with AUCs ranging from 0.66 to 0.99. Parameters based on single anatomic locations had a wide range of AUCs.

cards.headline: Prevalence of operating room occupational health cluster

source.title: Prevalence of operating room occupational health cluster: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: The prevalence of Operating Room Occupational is high, with musculoskeletal pain, depression, and occupational exposure being particularly severe. Healthcare management should prioritize the physical and mental health of operating room personnel, optimize workflows, and strengthen occupational protection measures.

cards.headline: Efficacy, symptoms, and safety of second-line PBC therapies: a network meta-analysis

source.title: Efficacy, symptoms, and safety of second-line PBC therapies: a network meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: The treatment paradigm for UDCA-refractory PBC is shifting towards individualized care. While bezafibrate offers unparalleled potency for POISE criteria, seladelpar 10 mg provides the most advantageous clinical balance, achieving deep biochemical remission (ALP normalization) alongside profound pruritus relief and a favorable safety profile.

cards.headline: Vitreoretinal bioadhesives: Translational challenges and innovative perspectives

source.title: Vitreoretinal bioadhesives: Translational challenges and innovative perspectives.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: Building on this analysis, we outline an innovative perspective on the key functional and translational design principles for next-generation vitreoretinal bioadhesives and propose a mechanism-informed roadmap for scalable clinical translation.

cards.headline: Conjunctival Biopsy in Ocular Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid

source.title: Conjunctival Biopsy in Ocular Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid.
source.excerpt: This perspective highlights the practical considerations, limitations, and evolving role of conjunctival biopsy in oMMP, underscoring its selective role within a multidisciplinary approach to the diagnosis and management of cicatricial conjunctivitis.

cards.headline: Barriers to artificial intelligence applications in ophthalmology

source.title: Barriers to artificial intelligence applications in ophthalmology: beyond diagnostic accuracy toward patient outcomes, workflow integration, ethics, and trust.
source.excerpt: The central challenge for ophthalmic AI is therefore no longer model development alone, but disciplined clinical translation, including prospective evaluation, operational workflow measurement, equity assessment, lifecycle monitoring, transparent governance, and trustworthy implementation.

cards.headline: From binary labels to dynamic landscapes

source.title: From binary labels to dynamic landscapes: The evolving computational prediction of protein-RNA interactions through tasks and deep learning paradigms.
source.excerpt: Finally, the study outlines practical recommendations for field-wide benchmarking and looks ahead to the integration with spatial omics and the development of dynamic, generative landscapes of RPIs to better empower biomedical research.

cards.headline: O die ihr glaubt, sagt nicht (zum Propheten): „ra’ina sondern sagt: „unzurna Und hört …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:104
source.excerpt: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تقولوا للرسول محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم: راعنا، أي: راعنا سمعك، فافهم عنا وأفهمنا; لأن اليهود كانوا يقولونها للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يلوون ألسنتهم بها، يقصدون سبَّه ونسبته إلى الرعونة، وقولوا -أيها المؤمنون- بدلا منها: انظرنا، أي انظر إلينا وتعهَّدْنا، وهي تؤدي المعنى المطلوب نفسه واسمعوا ما يتلى عليكم من كتاب ربكم وافهموه. وللجاحدين عذاب موجع.

cards.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقُولُوا۟ رَٰعِنَا وَقُولُوا۟ ٱنظُرْنَا وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ ۗ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
cards.translation: O die ihr glaubt, sagt nicht (zum Propheten): „ra’ina sondern sagt: „unzurna Und hört (auf den Propheten)! Und für die Ungläubigen wird es schmerzhafte Strafe geben.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Manners in Speech: Allah forbade His believing servants from imitating the behavior and deeds of the disbelievers. The Jews used to use devious words that hide what they really meant. May Allah's curse be upon them.

cards.headline: Weder diejenigen unter den Leuten der Schrift, die ungläubig sind …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:105
source.excerpt: ما يحب الكفار من أهل الكتاب والمشركين أن يُنزَّل عليكم أدنى خير من ربكم قرآنًا أو علمًا، أو نصرًا أو بشارة. والله يختص برحمته مَن يشاء مِن عباده بالنبوة والرسالة. والله ذو العطاء الكثير الواسع.

cards.arabic: مَّا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَلَا ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
cards.translation: Weder diejenigen unter den Leuten der Schrift, die ungläubig sind, noch die Götzendiener möchten, daß euch etwas Gutes von eurem Herrn offenbart wird. Aber Allah zeichnet mit Seinem Erbarmen aus, wen Er will, denn Allah besitzt große Huld.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Manners in Speech: Allah forbade His believing servants from imitating the behavior and deeds of the disbelievers. The Jews used to use devious words that hide what they really meant. May Allah's curse be upon them.
